---
title: "Check paperwork saved for later"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-05 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Read the copies of paperwork that groomers saved with **Check it later**, and
record the dates of each shot.

## Applies to

Managers only.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, click **Paperwork to check**. The list opens, one
   line per copy, with the dog, the owner, and **AI has read it** if the AI
   has already read the copy.
2. Click **Check it** beside the copy. The dog's **paperwork** box opens at
   the top of the list.

### Read the copy and enter the dates

{{< include /_shared/checking-a-copy.qmd >}}

6. Click **Done checking**. The box closes.

   To stop part-way and come back to it, click **Save for later** instead.
   The copy stays on the list.

### Remove a copy

If a copy is not paperwork for this dog, or cannot be read at all:

1. Click **Remove** beside it.
2. When asked **Remove this copy** of the dog's **paperwork?**, click **OK**.
   Its pages are deleted.

## Result

The copy leaves the **Paperwork to check** list, and the dog's card shows the
shots you saved. Shots you save need no second look.
